name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-contacts
title: Apple Contacts
description: Search and read Apple Contacts — resolves numbers and emails to names, writes off by default

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CONTACTS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.
